# `regexp_replace`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
regexp_replace(str, regexp, rep[, position])
```

Replaces all substrings of `str` that match `regexp` with `rep`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [3, 4] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT regexp_replace('100-200', '(\\d+)', 'num');
```

Result:

```text
num-num
```

```sql
SELECT regexp_replace('100-200', r'(\d+)', 'num');
```

Result:

```text
num-num
```
